{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(df.head())

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}")

# Check unique values in channel
print(f"\nUnique channels: {df['channel'].unique()}")

# Check distribution of customer_segment
print(f"\nCustomer segment distribution:\n{df['customer_segment'].value_counts()}")

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f"\nNumber of -1 values in customer_age: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Check revenue column type
print(f"Revenue dtype: {df['revenue'].dtype}")"}
